title: THE “FEAR NOTS” OF JESUS’ NATIVITY IN LUKE
theme: The nativity announcements bring assurance to Zacharias, approval to Mary, and joyful good news to the shepherds amid their fears.
proposition: God's words of comfort surrounding Jesus' nativity assuage fear and doubt with assurance, favor, and good news.
sermonQuestion: How do the three nativity “fear not” announcements in Luke answer fear and doubt?
